The presence of a dead or dying tree is the most frequent reason for tree removal, yet sometimes we have to remove trees, living and dead. Maybe they are too close to your home or maybe their root system is causing foundation issues; whatever the reason, we are always available to diagnose a diseased tree or determine whether a tree is a hazard to your property. In fact, one of the most serious issues that homeowners have with their trees is the possibility of a tree falling and causing damage to their home. Storm season, particularly hurricane season, can exacerbate this issue. In fact, homeowners lose billions of dollars each year as a result of storm-damaged trees falling and destroying property. Give us a call before the storm season begins this year for a free tree removal quote.
